surface: Complete @mantine/form 9.5.0 runtime and type surface: useForm, useField, providers, actions, validators, nested paths, list operations, sync/async validation, schemas, watchers, and controlled/uncontrolled input props.
divergences: Hooks use Octane lifecycle and state primitives.
Input and submit callbacks receive native browser events instead of React synthetic events.
ssr: Form state and validation are deterministic during server rendering; browser event attachment activates during hydration.
